item.title: Carl - rural america mental care
item.description:
Source: Carl

Angela

Background

Ravaged by 2 men and their dog at age 16 (1988), Angela, an Italian American, developed mental instability and was institutionalized.
Not visited by family, she would call religious places nearby.
She was visited by church folk who twice impregnated her. Kids were sent to foster care system.

First contact

At age 34, in 2006, she called a university town ISKCON temple. Carl was sent. The institution was 1.5 hours away. After 2-3 visits, she offered her body; but was releived when told that it was not needed. Within some 5 months, she was ok.

item.title: Sleep paralysis
item.description:
Source: TW

Many people seem to be curious about the old hag phenomenon. In short, it is a peculiar experience where you are undergoing sleep paralysis or a comparable state where one is unable to respond, when the figure of an old hag or a violent, gray-haired woman with disheveled hair comes and sits on your abdomen or chest (folk mantra-traditions see it as jyeShThA or dhUmAvatI or their agents).

It is often accompanied by a combination of one or more of the following:
a sense of dread, choking or an inability to breathe or move.
Eventually, one awakes, and it vanishes.
